# Anodex v0.1.7 - Table of Contents

Elixir bindings for ANODE disk-resident vector search (ANN)

## Pages

- [Anodex](https://anodex.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Anodex](https://anodex.hexdocs.pm/Anodex.md): Elixir bindings for ANODE vector search library.
- [Anodex.Anode](https://anodex.hexdocs.pm/Anodex.Anode.md): Single-node disk-resident ANN index.
- [Anodex.Manode](https://anodex.hexdocs.pm/Anodex.Manode.md): Sharded disk-resident ANN index.
- [Anodex.Options](https://anodex.hexdocs.pm/Anodex.Options.md): Configuration options for Anode/Manode indices.

- [Anodex.StalenessInfo](https://anodex.hexdocs.pm/Anodex.StalenessInfo.md): Staleness information returned with search results.
